ValidationRule.description: For Sales Offers, Presence of FF Information > 10, Type has to be Campaign.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( Case__r.RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ Case__r.Presence_of_Frequent_Flyer_Information__c >= 10, ISPICKVAL ( Case__r.Type , "Adhoc" )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For more than 10 Frequent Flyer Request, you will have to request a Sales Offer Campaign
